Name: AccordionCollapseAll
Description: Function to collapse all the expanded items of a given accordion.

Name: AccordionExpandAll
Description: Function to expand all the collapsed items of a given accordion.

Name: AccordionItemAllowTitleEvents
Description: Enable the events of a given AccordionItem title’s elements. Use this action to trigger element events (e.g. link on click) without opening/closing the Accordion Item.

Name: AccordionItemCollapse
Description: Closes an AccordionItem with a given identifier.

Name: AccordionItemExpand
Description: Opens an AccordionItem with a given identifier.

Name: AddFavicon
Description:
Add a favicon to your web application by providing the icon's URL.
This action should be used in the Layout OnReady event or on an OnApplicationStart event.
Note: This action is only compatible with Chrome, Firefox and Edge.

Name: BinaryToURLImage
Description: Generates an image URL from a binary file. This action can be used to generate the URl to be used in patterns like the LighboxImage or the OutSystems Maps Marker.

Name: CarouselDisableOnRender
Description:
Prevents the Carousel block from auto-updating every time that there’s a change on the Carousel items. This will prevent unnecessary destroy/init cycles of the provider, resulting in better performance.

This action can be used in combination with the CarouselEnableOnRender action (for instance, before adding a new class to an element inside the Carousel, use the CarouselDisableOnRender action and after doing it, use the CarouselEnableOnRender action, so that the carousel can auto-update if needed). 
 
By default, the Carousel auto-updates itself.

Name: CarouselEnableOnRender
Description:
Prevents the Carousel block from auto-updating every time that there’s a change on the Carousel items. This will prevent unnecessary destroy/init cycles of the provider, resulting in better performance.

This action can be used in combination with the CarouselDisableOnRender action (for instance, before adding a new class to an element inside the Carousel, use the CarouselDisableOnRender action and after doing it, use the CarouselEnableOnRender action, so that the carousel can auto-update if needed). 
 
By default, the Carousel auto-updates itself.

Name: CarouselGoTo
Description: Set the item that Carousel will go to.

Name: CarouselNext
Description: Use to move the Carousel to the next item.

Name: CarouselPrevious
Description: Use to move the carousel to the previous item.

Name: CarouselToggleDrag
Description: Enable the drag to navigate between items.

Name: ConfigureOfflineDataSync
Description: Offline data synchronization settings.

Name: DatePickerClear
Description: Resets the selected dates (if any) and clears the input of a DatePicker with a given identifier.

Name: DatePickerClose
Description: Closes a Datepicker block with a given identifier.

Name: DatePickerDisableDays
Description:
Set a list of specific days unavailable for selection on the DatePicker.

Note:
- Due to a provider issue, when using this action on the DatePickerRange, the component behaves differently in Web and Mobile. In Web, it is not possible to select an interval that includes disabled dates. In Mobile, it's possible to do it. Our team is working to ensure an identical experience for Web and Mobile and will update this action as soon as the provider reviews the component behavior.

Name: DatePickerDisableWeekDays
Description:
Disable one or more days of the week on a given DatePicker.

Note: 
- Due to a provider issue, when using this action on the DatePickerRange, the component behaves differently in Web and Mobile. In Web, it is not possible to select an interval that includes disabled dates. In Mobile, it's possible to do it. Our team is working to ensure an identical experience for Web and Mobile and will update this action as soon as the provider reviews the component behavior.

Name: DatePickerOpen
Description: Opens a Datepicker block with a given identifier.

Name: DatePickerRangeUpdateDates
Description: Update the selected start and end dates shown in a given DatePickerRange.

Name: DatePickerSetEditableInput
Description: Use this action to enable the end-user to write on the DatePicker input. By default, the input is read-only.

Name: DatePickerSetLanguage
Description: Set a new language on a DatePicker block with a given identifier. All the elements shown in the DatePicker will the translated into the selected language.

Name: DatePickerToggleNativeBehavior
Description: Use this action to control the DatePicker behavior when opened in mobile. By default, the DatePicker is opened as native, in mobile.

Name: DatePickerUpdateDate
Description: Update the selected date shown in a given DatePicker.

Name: DisableTabItem
Description: Disable a TabHeaderItem with a specific identifier.

Name: DropdownClear
Description: Unselects all selected values of a Dropdown (DropdownTags, DropdownSearch) with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownClearValidation
Description: Clears the validation style of a Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownClose
Description: Closes the options list of a Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) block with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownDisable
Description: Sets a Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) with given identifier as disabled.

Name: DropdownEnable
Description: Sets a Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) with given identifier as enabled.

Name: DropdownGetSelectedValues
Description: Returns a list with the selected values of a Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownNotValid
Description: Apply the invalid style to a Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownOpen
Description: Opens the Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) block with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownServerSideClear
Description: Unselects all selected values of a DropdownServerSide with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownServerSideClearValidation
Description: Clears the validation style of a DropdownServerSide with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownServerSideClose
Description: Closes the options list of a DropdownServerSide block with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownServerSideDisable
Description: Sets a DropdownServerSide with given identifier as disabled.

Name: DropdownServerSideEnable
Description: Sets a DropdownServerSide with given identifier as enabled.

Name: DropdownServerSideNotValid
Description: Apply the invalid style to a DropdownServerSide with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownServerSideOpen
Description: Opens the options list of a DropdownServerSide block with a given identifier.

Name: DropdownSetValue
Description:
Set the selected values of a Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) block. 
Please note, that doing this doesn’t update the new selected value on your Data. 
You will need to do it manually, after the action is used.

Name: DropdownTogglePopup
Description: Enables or disables the default behavior of Dropdowns (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) of opening as a popup in mobile apps (responsive and native). By default, Dropdowns open as popups in mobile apps (responsive and native).

Name: EnableTabItem
Description: Enable a TabHeaderItem with a specific identifier.

Name: EndOfflineDataSync
Description: Disables the offline data synchronization.

Name: FeedbackMessageClose
Description: Closes the FeedbackMessage that is currently open.

Name: FeedbackMessageShow
Description: Shows a FeedbackMessage with a specified message. You can enable HTML encoding, add CSS classes, and set the behavior on click.

Name: FlipContentBack
Description: Shows the back of the FlipContent.

Name: FlipContentFront
Description: Shows the front of the FlipContent.

Name: FlipContentToggle
Description: Flips the content of the FlipContent with the ID.

Name: FocusFirstInvalidInput
Description: Set the focus on the first invalid input of the screen. Due to the unsupported scrollend event on Safari/iOS, the smooth transition is disabled and the invalid input will be focused directly.

Name: FormatMinutes
Description: Formats a number of minutes as hours and minutes, e.g. 2250 -> "37h30" (Separator "h") or "37:30" (Separator ":"). Minutes always have 2 digits.

Name: GetBrowser
Description: Identifies the browser being used.

Name: GetDeviceOrientation
Description: Get the current device orientation

Name: GetDeviceType
Description: Get the current device type

Name: GetIsTouch
Description: Identifies if the device has a touchscreen.

Name: GetNetworkStatus
Description: Check if device is online.

Name: GetNetworkType
Description:
Gets the type of the connection. 
The connection type is obtained via the web standard API "navigator.connection.type", which implies that it will return one of the following values:
- bluetooth
- cellular
- ethernet
- none
- other
- unknown
- wifi
- wimax

See more information in https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/NetworkInformation/type

Name: GetOS
Description: Identifies the operating system being used.

Name: GetWeekStart
Description: Returns the Monday of the week that contains Date.

Name: IsDesktop
Description: Check if the current device is desktop

Name: IsLayoutNative
Description: Check if the current layout is native.

Name: IsMenuDraggable
Description: Check if the menu is draggable or not.

Name: IsPhone
Description: Check if the current device is phone

Name: IsRTL
Description: Function that exposes if RTL is applied.

Name: IsRunningAsPWA
Description: Check if running as PWA.

Name: IsTablet
Description: Check if the current device is tablet

Name: IsWebApp
Description: Returns true if using a WebApp Template.

Name: LayoutDestroy
Description: Pre-defined actions to properly destroy layout for reactive and native applications.

Name: LayoutReady
Description: Pre-defined actions to prepare your layout for reactive and native applications.

Name: ListAll
Description: Determines if all the elements in the list satisfy the given condition.

Name: ListAny
Description: Determines if any of the elements in the list satisfies the given condition.

Name: ListAppend
Description: Adds an element to the end of a list.

Name: ListAppendAll
Description: Adds the elements of the source list to the end of the destination list.

Name: ListClear
Description: Removes all elements from a list.

Name: ListDuplicate
Description: Duplicates the elements of a list into another list.

Name: ListFilter
Description: Returns a new list with the elements from the List parameter satisfying the given condition.

Name: ListIndexOf
Description: Returns the position of the first element of the List parameter that satisfies the given condition, or -1 if no element satisfying the condition was found.

Name: ListInsert
Description: Inserts an element in a specific position of a list.

Name: ListItemHint
Description: Action to hint users that the list item has swipe actions available to use, either on the left or right side. In case of both left and right actions, the default animation is on the left. This animation will be active when there are left and/or right actions available, based on the animation time parameter.

Name: ListRemove
Description: Removes an element from a specific position of a list.

Name: ListSort
Description: Sorts the elements of the List parameter by the given criteria.

Name: LoadOutSystemsUIScript
Description: Checks if the OutSystemsUI script is already defined. Otherwise, the script is loaded. This is used on DevicedDetection client actions, that could be used in contexts where the script was not loaded yet. Please note, don't use calls to OutSystems UI API on this action.

Name: MasterDetailSetContentFocus
Description:
Use this action on the ListItemOnClick action from the list in your Master Detail. 

This is needed for Accessibility compliance, as it allows the changing of focus between the detail and the next listitem.

Name: MenuDestroy
Description: Pre-defined action to properly destroy menu for reactive and native applications.

Name: MenuHide
Description: Closes the extended menu content.

Name: MenuReady
Description: Pre-defined action to prepare your menu for reactive and native applications.

Name: MenuShow
Description: Opens the extended menu content.

Name: MonthPickerClear
Description: Cleans a MonthPicker with a given identifier.

Name: MonthPickerClose
Description: Closes a MonthPicker block with a given identifier.

Name: MonthPickerOpen
Description: Opens a MonthPicker block with a given identifier.

Name: MonthPickerSetEditableInput
Description: Use this action to enable the end-user to write on the MonthPicker input. By default, the input is read-only.

Name: MonthPickerSetLanguage
Description: Set a new language on a MonthPicker block with a given identifier. All the elements shown in the MonthPicker will the translated into the selected language.

Name: MoveElement
Description:
Action that moves elements on the DOM tree. Define the WidgetID of the element to be moved and the Target selector that will receive the element.

Example: $actions.MoveElement($parameters.WidgetId, ".active-screen .screen");

Name: NotificationClose
Description: Hides a Notification with a given identifier.

Name: NotificationOpen
Description: Shows a Notification with a given identifier.

Name: OverflowMenuClose
Description: Closes a OverflowMenu with a given identifier.

Name: OverflowMenuDisable
Description: Sets a OverflowMenu with given identifier as disabled.

Name: OverflowMenuEnable
Description: Sets a OverflowMenu with given identifier as enabled.

Name: OverflowMenuOpen
Description: Opens a OverflowMenu with a given identifier.

Name: ProgressApplyGradient
Description: Use to apply a gradient to the ProgressBar or ProgressCircle.

Name: RangeSliderDisable
Description: Method that will set RangeSlider with given RangeSlider ID as Disabled.

Name: RangeSliderEnable
Description: Method that will set RangeSlider with given RangeSlider ID as Enabled.

Name: RatingDisable
Description: Method that will set Rating with given Rating ID as Disabled.

Name: RatingEnable
Description: Method that will set Rating with given Rating ID as Enabled.

Name: ResetProgressBar
Description: Resets the ProgressBar value to the Progress value.

Name: ResetProgressCircle
Description: Resets the ProgressCircle value to the Progress value.

Name: ResetRangeSlider
Description: Resets the RangeSlider value to the StartingValue.

Name: ResetRangeSliderInterval
Description: Resets the RangeSlider value to the IntervalStart and IntervalEnd values.

Name: ScrollToElement
Description: Automatically scroll to a given element on the page.

Name: SetAccessibilityRole
Description:
Use this action to set the aria-role of an element, for better Accessibility compliance.

E.g. use this action to change Alert default values for the role attribute. This action should be used only when the pattern's visibility is set to true.

Name: SetActiveElement
Description: Allows to change the selected state of Cards and List Items. Set a Widget Id and the Active state to change an element on the screen.

Name: SetActiveMenuItems
Description: Adds the selected states to menu items.

Name: SetActiveTab
Description: Action to change to specific TabsHeaderItem.

Name: SetAriaHidden
Description: Use this action to toggle the status of the aria-hidden attribute of an element.

Name: SetCarouselDirection
Description: Set the direction in which the carousel is sliding when it is automatically looping (Loop). By default, the carousel direction is from left to right.

Name: SetCurrentLocale
Description: Set the locale to change your app's display language.

Name: SetDeviceBreakpoints
Description:
Use this action to set custom breakpoints for Phone and Tablet.

Must be used on the OnApplicationStart of your App.

Name: SetFlatpickrConfigs
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the DatePicker Pattern, to set additional configs supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://flatpickr.js.org/options/

Name: SetFlatpickrEvent
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the DatePicker Pattern, to set additional events supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://flatpickr.js.org/events/

Name: SetFocus
Description: Use this action to focus the element.

Name: SetHighchartsChartConfigs
Description:
Extend the properties of the chart blocks with additional Highcharts configurations.
Due to security reasons, configurations/properties using callback functions, objects (e.g. arrays) cannot be used since they will not be parsed.
Check all Highcharts chart properties at: https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/

Name: SetHighchartsSeriesConfigs
Description:
Extend the properties of a series of a chart with additional Highcharts configurations.
Due to security reasons, configurations/properties using callback functions, objects (e.g. arrays) cannot be used since they will not be parsed.
Check all Highharts chart properties at: https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/series

Name: SetHighchartsXAxisConfigs
Description:
Extend the properties of the x-axis of a chart with additional Highcharts configurations.
Due to security reasons, configurations/properties using callback functions, objects (e.g. arrays) cannot be used since they will not be parsed.
Check all Highharts chart properties at: https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/xAxis

Name: SetHighchartsYAxisConfigs
Description:
Extend the properties of the y-axis of a chart with additional Highcharts configurations.
Due to security reasons, configurations/properties using callback functions, objects (e.g. arrays) cannot be used since they will not be parsed.
Check all Highharts chart properties at: https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/yAxis

Name: SetLang
Description: Use this action to specify the language of the element's content. E.g. "en"

Name: SetMenuAttributes
Description: Supports the items accessible on the menu.

Name: SetMenuIcon
Description: Changes the menu icon automatic behavior.

Name: SetMenuIconListeners
Description: Makes the menu accessibility-ready.

Name: SetMenuListeners
Description: Makes the menu navigation accessibility-ready.

Name: SetNoUISliderConfigs
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the RangeSlider Pattern, to set additional configs supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://refreshless.com/nouislider/slider-options/

Name: SetNoUISliderEvent
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the RangeSlider Pattern, to set additional events supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://refreshless.com/nouislider/events-callbacks/

Name: SetProgressBarValue
Description: Set a value on the Progress Bar.

Name: SetProgressCircleValue
Description: Set a value on the Progress Circle.

Name: SetRangeSliderChangeOnDragEnd
Description:
Use this action on the Initialize event or on the Screen's OnReady event.

By using this action, the change events will only be triggered when the user releases the slider.

Tip: if you're refreshing a query based on the value of the slider, we recommend using this action.

Name: SetRangeSliderIntervalChangeOnDragEnd
Description:
Use this action on the Initialize event or on the Screen's OnReady event.

By using this action, the change events will only be triggered when the user releases the slider.

Tip: if you're refreshing a query based on the value of the slider, we recommend using this action.

Name: SetRangeSliderIntervalValue
Description: Set a value on the RangeSliderInterval.

Name: SetRangeSliderValue
Description: Set a value on the RangeSlider.

Name: SetSelectedTableRow
Description:
To be used to complement Bulk Actions logic. Drag this action to your checkbox OnChange action.

This will afftect the styles of the checkbox used, and the selected table rows, containing a checked checkbox.

Name: SetSplideConfigs
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the Carousel Pattern, to set additional events supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://splidejs.com/v3/guides/options/

Name: SetSplideEvent
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the Carousel Pattern, to set additional configs supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://splidejs.com/v3/guides/events/#event-list

Name: SetVirtualSelectConfigs
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the Dropdown (DropdownTags or DropdownSearch) block, to set additional configs supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://sa-si-dev.github.io/virtual-select/#/properties

Name: SetVirtualSelectEvent
Description:
Use this action on the Initialized event of the DropdownTags or DropdownSearch, to set additional events supported by the provider.

Use this link to check all available configs: https://sa-si-dev.github.io/virtual-select/#/events

Name: SidebarClickOutsideToClose
Description: Use this action to enable/disable the click outside to close the Sidebar.

Name: SidebarClose
Description: Action to close the Sidebar block.

Name: SidebarOpen
Description: Action to open the Sidebar block.

Name: SidebarToggleSwipe
Description: Use this action to enable/disable the Sidebar swipe actions on Native Apps. By default, the swipe actions are enabled.

Name: SkipToContent
Description:
Action used on OutSystems UI layouts, to allow the user to skip the navigation elements on the screen, and tab directly into content.

By default, the MainContentWrapper.Id is used. Use the targetId parameter to set a custom target.

Name: StackedCardsSwipeLeft
Description: Call this action to swipe active card to left. You need to set the Stacked Cards ID (Widget Id).

Name: StackedCardsSwipeRight
Description: Call this action to swipe active card to right. You need to set the Stacked Cards ID (Widget Id).

Name: StackedCardsSwipeTop
Description: Call this action to swipe active card to top. You need to set the Stacked Cards ID (Widget Id).

Name: StackedCardsUpdate
Description: This action must be used on list remove action from OS platform. The UpdateStackedCards update all the cards and rearrange the order, scale and opacity for each one.

Name: StartOfflineDataSync
Description: This action starts the offline data synchronization in background.

Name: SubmenuClose
Description: Action to close the Submenu block.

Name: SubmenuOpen
Description: Action to open the Submenu block.

Name: SubmenuOpenOnHover
Description: Action to change the trigger that opens the Submenu block from click to hover.

Name: TabsToggleSwipe
Description: Use this action to set the Tabs to toggle using swipe actions on Native Apps, but rather control it using the Tabs Header.

Name: TextEllipsis
Description: Cut off text to input size ending in ...

Name: TimePickerClear
Description: Cleans a TimePicker with a given identifier.

Name: TimePickerClose
Description: Closes a TimePicker with a given identifier.

Name: TimePickerOpen
Description: Opens a TimePicker with a given identifier.

Name: TimePickerSetEditableInput
Description: Use this action to enable the end-user to write on the TimePicker input. By default, the input is read-only.

Name: TimePickerToggleNativeBehavior
Description: Use this action to control the TimePicker behavior when opened in mobile. By default, the TimePicker is opened as native, in mobile.

Name: TimePickerUpdateTime
Description: Update the selected time shown in a given TimePicker.

Name: ToggleSideMenu
Description: Expands the menu.

Name: ToggleTextSpacing
Description: Use this action to increase the letter spacing, word spacing and line-height across the application

Name: TooltipClose
Description: Action to close the Tooltip block.

Name: TooltipOpen
Description: Action to open the Tooltip block.

Name: UnsetFlatpickrEvent
Description: Remove an event handler from a given DatePicker block.

Name: UnsetNoUISliderEvent
Description: Remove an event handler from a given RangeSlider block.

Name: UnsetSplideEvent
Description: Remove an event handler from a given Carousel block.

Name: UnsetVirtualSelectEvent
Description: Remove an event handler from a given DropdownTags or DropdownSearch block.

Name: UpdateChartColorScheme
Description: A list of color values to use for the chart. Some of the formats accepted are: html, rgb, rgba and hex.

Name: VideoGetState
Description:
Returns the reproduction state of the video. The different states of the video are:
- Unstarted: if the video did not start being played.
- Playing: if the video is being played.
- Paused: if the video is currently paused.
- Ended: if the video is ended.

Name: VideoJumpToTime
Description: Jump to a specific time of a Video with a given identifier.

Name: VideoPause
Description: Pause a Video with a given identifier.

Name: VideoPlay
Description: Play a Video with a given identifier.
